description: This file contains unit tests for the CoreDataTuner class in the openmrs project, specifically testing methods related to reading, updating, and manipulating Liquibase change log files for core data SQL schema migrations.

classes.name: CoreDataTunerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the CoreDataTuner functionalities related to Liquibase changelog modifications in OpenMRS.

methods.name: shouldCreateUpdatedChangeLogFile
methods.description: Tests the creation of an updated changelog file by comparing the generated file with an expected XML.

methods.name: shouldDetachAndCacheChangeSets
methods.description: Ensures change sets are correctly detached from the document and cached internally.

methods.name: shouldAddChangeSets
methods.description: Verifies that change sets are correctly added back to a document and the table names are merged properly.

methods.name: shouldGetDatabaseChangeLogElement
methods.description: Checks retrieval of the main databaseChangeLog element from the XML document.

methods.name: shouldMergeTableNamesInTargetOrder
methods.description: Confirms merging of table name lists maintains the correct order and contains all elements.

methods.name: shouldDetectThatSecondListDoesNotContainFirstList
methods.description: Ensures correct exception handling when attempting to merge lists with missing elements.

methods.name: shouldUpdateAdminUser
methods.description: Tests updating admin user credentials within the changelog document.

methods.name: shouldGetTableNames
methods.description: Verifies extraction of table names from the changelog document.
